text:
Priya: Quick flag — canary cohort for 'credit_class' pricing experiment invoiced ~30% higher than expected. Looks like vendor mapping tags didn't get applied.
Tom: Which vendor invoice number? can you paste sample lines? :eyes:
Priya: Invoice: vendor_acme_2024-04-21 #INV-8421
Priya: Here's the CSV row we pulled from billing_export:
```
account_id,cohort_tag,usage_tokens,unit_price,total
acct_019,canary_credit_plus,120000,0.0008,96.0
acct_019,legacy_standard,120000,0.0006,72.0
```
Lina: Ok, that CSV shows both cohort tags for same account — looks like double-rate applied. Did we apply a fallback price for missing tag? :thinking:
Eddie: Product changed the tag key from `cohort_tag` -> `pricing_segment` in the experiment rollout last week. Ops PR updated the router but billing export taps the old key.
Sam: Oof — so billing pipeline is still reading `cohort_tag`. That explains the duplicate rows. Can we short-circuit and re-run export with the new mapping?
Grace: I can push a quick config change to the bill-export mapping service, but that requires a restart of the export worker. It'll take ~10m and a redeploy window.
Lina: If we re-run the export we need to avoid double-crediting customers. Suggest we create a patch that dedups by invoice id + account_id before re-ingest.
Tom: Agree. Also need to check vendor invoice #INV-8421 — if vendor already billed, we may need a credit memo.
Priya: Action items:
- Grace to patch mapping and redeploy export worker (ETA 10m)
- Lina to prepare dedupe script and dry-run on a subset
- Tom to reach out to vendor to hold settlement for INV-8421
- Sam to run reconciliation job after re-export and report variance
Lina: Starting dedupe script now against test slice — will post results.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-8421 flagged by anomaly detector: amount delta 33% vs expected. Auto-tagged for review.
Tom: @vendor-ops FYI — please don't settle INV-8421 until we confirm. I'll DM the vendor contact.
Priya: Thanks all. If the dedupe looks clean, we can avoid issuing credits and just re-ingest corrected invoice lines. Please post final numbers here.
Lina: Dry-run dedupe: removed 1 duplicate row for acct_019, delta corrected to 0.8% after mapping fix. Will schedule re-export.
Grace: Redeploy completed. Export worker restarted at 1745604500.
Sam: Reconciliation job run complete. Net variance for canary cohort: +0.9% (within threshold). I will close the ticket after vendor confirms hold.
Tom: Vendor responded — they will hold settlement until EOD PT. :thumbsup: 
Priya: Closing loop: thanks team. We should add a pre-rollout checklist item to confirm billing key name parity between product and billing for future experiments.
Eddie: Will add to rollout checklist. Thanks.
